# okstatus_monitor_group (Resource)

A monitor group — a folder of the Monitors page. A monitor belongs to one group at most: listing it in `monitor_ids` takes it out of its previous group. Destroying the group keeps its monitors, ungrouped.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "okstatus_monitor_group" "payments" {
  name        = "Payments"
  description = "Everything on the checkout path"
  tags        = ["prod"]

  # Attached to every monitor that joins the group.
  alert_channel_ids = [okstatus_alert_channel.team_discord.id]

  monitor_ids = [
    okstatus_monitor.api.id,
    okstatus_monitor.database.id,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.

### Optional

- `alert_channel_ids` (Set of String) Alert channels of the group: a monitor that joins the group gets them attached. Monitors already in the group are not touched when this list changes. If you also set `alert_channel_ids` on an `okstatus_monitor` of this group, repeat these ids there, or the next `apply` detaches them from that monitor.
- `color` (String) Color of the folder: a preset key of the dashboard's palette, as shown by `data.okstatus_monitor_groups` on a group colored in the dashboard (e.g. `aurora`, `green`).
- `description` (String) Free text shown under the group's name.
- `monitor_ids` (Set of String) The group's monitors (ids of `okstatus_monitor` or `okstatus_llm_monitor` resources). This is the complete membership: a monitor moved into the group from the dashboard is taken out again at the next `apply`.
- `tags` (Set of String) The group's own tags (10 at most). They are not copied onto its monitors.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Group ID.
